authorization: Owner explicitly requested: make a new attempt. This permits this one new local attempt after the retained preparation failure; no earlier clock was reopened and no further retry was made.

workload.clockScope: Includes one cached offline Release build, focused controls, model intake/startup, both requests, power observations, cleanup and evidence/manifest retention; excludes writing the final small clock receipt itself.

metrics.timeToFirstToken: Client request start after verified HTTP readiness through first nonempty content-token receipt. Includes broker forwarding, exact-count admission and any remaining asynchronous model/device preparation; excludes startup elapsed before HTTP readiness.
metrics.generationTokensPerSecond: (reported completion usage - 1) / (last content-token receipt time - first content-token receipt time). Each successful capture has eight ASCII content deltas, eight reported tokens and seven measured intervals, supported by the pinned non-speculative per-committed-token callback source.
metrics.scope: Public local broker HTTP/SSE client observations including transport, receive coalescing and synchronous observer receipt I/O; not isolated kernel decode or sustained throughput.
metrics.memory: OS lifetime peak Job commit including descendants and startup. Excludes mapped-file residency and device allocations; not total RAM use. Admission remains 15.5 GiB available RAM.
metrics.accelerationScope: Default PQ2 acceleration policy attempts Snapdragon X2 native-q2 with CPU fallback. Effective CPU/NPU execution is not exposed by authenticated readiness and was not independently observed. PTQ1 uses the CPU path.

qualification.crossVersionLimit: November 3 measurements used direct sandboxed backend HTTP; this capture uses public broker HTTP/SSE and a newer runtime/default policy. Do not derive a controlled cross-version speedup from these observations.
